fabricated_details: Potential mechanical wear or bearing issue
Inspect M-11 for source of whining noise; check bearings and lubrication
Confirm M-01 spindle stability; monitor for recurrence of overload alarms
Restore M-08 to full speed once additional staffing is available

rationale: The report captures all reported items well but invents multiple maintenance steps, causes, and recommendations not present in the input. Severity choices are generally defensible although M-08 is marked high, and readability is very high with clean formatting. It poorly handles uncertainty by inventing monitoring and inspection tasks.
